/* Vollbild: Alle Elemente, die unsere Bereiche umschliessen, ohne Rand und ohne Breitenbegrenzung */
html:has(.sth){margin-left:0!important;margin-right:0!important;padding:0!important;overflow-x:clip}
html:has(.sth) body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;border:0!important;overflow-x:clip}
html:has(.sth) body *:has(.sth):not(.sth){margin:0!important;padding:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;border-width:0!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;box-sizing:border-box}
/* Ende Vollbild */
/* STOP the HATE, Relaunch 2026
   Einfuegen unter: Design > Customizer > Zusaetzliches CSS
   Die Schriften (Archivo, Instrument Sans) sind in diese Datei eingebettet. Es ist kein Schrift-Upload noetig.
   Bild-URLs weiter unten pruefen und ggf. anpassen (Pfad aus der Mediathek kopieren).
*/
@font-face{font-family:'Archivo';font-style:normal;font-weight:800;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Archivo';font-style:normal;font-weight:900;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Instrument Sans';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Instrument Sans';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}

body .sth{--img-dark:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-streifen-dunkel.webp");--img-light:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-streifen-hell.webp");--img-k1:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-kachel-hasskriminalitaet.webp");--img-k2:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-kachel-dunkelziffer.webp");--img-k3:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-kachel-hass-im-internet.webp");--img-k4:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-kachel-zeuge.webp");--img-k5:url("https://stop-the-hate.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/sth-kachel-polizei.webp")}

body .sth{--navy:#013065; --navy-deep:#01234C; --teal:#00ACB6; --blue:#0084B4; --pink:#FF2B9C; --yellow:#FFB001; --purple:#7A0D78; --plum:#4F004F;
  --lblue:#00569D; --red:#D40B4D; --ice:#EEF5FB; --line:#D5E1EE; --muted:#41597A; --ink:#0B2545;
  --stripes:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal) 0 20%,var(--blue) 20% 40%,var(--purple) 40% 60%,var(--plum) 60% 75%,var(--pink) 75% 90%,var(--yellow) 90% 100%);
  --display:'Archivo','Arial Black',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:'Instrument Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px; --pad:clamp(20px,4vw,56px);}
body .sth *,body .sth *::before,body .sth *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body .sth{margin:0;font-family:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body .sth h1,body .sth h2,body .sth h3,body .sth h4,body .sth p,body .sth ol{margin:0}
body .sth h1,body .sth h2,body .sth h3,body .sth h4{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.04;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth a{color:inherit}
body .sth section[id]{scroll-margin-top:100px}
body .sth .s-wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 var(--pad)}
body .sth .s-skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0}
body .sth .s-skip:focus{left:16px;top:16px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;z-index:200}
body .sth :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--lblue);outline-offset:3px}
body .sth .s-hero :focus-visible,body .sth .s-util :focus-visible,body .sth .s-join :focus-visible,body .sth footer :focus-visible{outline-color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth svg.s-i{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;flex-shrink:0}
body .sth .s-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:56px;padding:0 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--body);transition:transform .15s,background .15s,color .15s}
body .sth .s-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
body .sth .s-btn-yellow{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-btn-ghost:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-btn-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-btn-sm{min-height:44px;padding:0 22px;font-size:16px}
body .sth .s-util{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#fff;font-size:14.72px}
body .sth .s-util .s-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;min-height:46px;gap:16px}
body .sth .s-util .s-left,body .sth .s-util .s-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
body .sth .s-sos{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:999px}
body .sth .s-util button{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 0}
body .sth .s-util .s-lang{opacity:.85}
body .sth .s-hdr{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
body .sth .s-hdr .s-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:92px;gap:24px}
body .sth .s-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0}
body .sth .s-brand img{height:72px;width:auto;display:block}
body .sth .s-brand span{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.2px;line-height:1.25;max-width:144px}
body .sth .s-nav{display:flex;gap:34px;font-weight:600}
body .sth .s-nav a{text-decoration:none;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent}
body .sth .s-nav a:hover{border-color:var(--pink)}
body .sth .s-burger{display:none;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;place-items:center}
body .sth .s-stripe{height:10px;background:var(--stripes)}
body .sth .s-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(1,48,101,.97) 0,rgba(1,48,101,.9) 46%,rgba(1,48,101,.3) 100%),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy);
  padding-top:clamp(48px,7vw,96px)}
body .sth .s-hero .s-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);align-items:center;padding-bottom:clamp(150px,16vw,230px)}
body .sth .s-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15.2px;margin-bottom:30px}
body .sth .s-hero h1{color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(51.2px,8vw,112px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.04em}
body .sth .s-hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth .s-lead{font-size:clamp(18.4px,1.7vw,22.4px);line-height:1.5;max-width:544px;margin:30px 0 38px;color:#E4EEF9}
body .sth .s-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
body .sth .s-hero-art{position:relative;padding:20px 0}
body .sth .s-hero-art{display:flex;justify-content:center}
body .sth .s-hero-art::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6% 2%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,255,255,.24),rgba(255,255,255,0))}
body .sth .s-hero-logo{position:relative;z-index:1;height:clamp(300px,34vw,500px);width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 24px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.38))}
body .sth .s-bar{position:absolute;z-index:0;height:24px;transform:skewY(-33.7deg)}
body .sth .s-b1{background:var(--pink);width:190px;left:-80px;bottom:16%}
body .sth .s-b2{background:var(--yellow);width:140px;right:-56px;top:8%}
body .sth .s-b3{background:var(--teal);width:96px;right:-34px;bottom:28%}
body .sth .s-finder{display:flow-root;position:relative;z-index:2;background:#fff var(--img-light) right bottom/cover no-repeat;padding-bottom:clamp(120px,15vw,240px)}
body .sth .s-finder-card{margin-top:calc(-1*clamp(100px,12vw,160px));background:#fff;border-radius:32px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(1,35,76,.22);padding:clamp(22px,4vw,56px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,64px)}
body .sth .s-finder h2{font-size:clamp(35.2px,4.4vw,57.6px);font-weight:900}
body .sth .s-finder .s-sub{color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 26px;max-width:480px}
body .sth .s-opts{display:grid;gap:10px}
body .sth .s-opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:12px 18px;min-height:68px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:19px!important;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,color .15s}
body .sth .s-opt:hover{border-color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-opt .s-ic{width:40px;height:40px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ice);color:var(--lblue);display:grid;place-items:center}
body .sth .s-opt.s-danger .s-ic{background:#FBE3EB;color:var(--red)}
body .sth .s-opt[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-opt.s-danger[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
body .sth .s-opt[aria-pressed="true"] .s-ic{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-result{background:var(--ice);border-radius:24px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px}
body .sth .s-rhead h3{font-size:clamp(27.2px,2.8vw,38.4px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
body .sth .s-rhead p{color:var(--muted)}
body .sth .s-rows{display:grid;gap:10px}
body .sth .s-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;background:#fff;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 20px;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
body .sth .s-row:hover{border-color:var(--lblue);transform:translateX(4px)}
body .sth .s-row strong{display:block;font-size:18px;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-row span{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
body .sth .s-row .s-ar{color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-steps-l{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
body .sth .s-rowstep{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 22px}
body .sth .s-rowstep b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:35.2px;font-weight:900;color:var(--lblue);width:34px;line-height:1}
body .sth .s-rowstep span{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:20.8px;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-rowstep.s-hot{background:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-rowstep.s-hot span{color:#fff}
body .sth .s-rowstep.s-hot b{color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth .s-hint{font-size:15.2px;color:var(--muted)}
body .sth .s-hint a{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
body .sth .s-result .s-btn{align-self:flex-start}
body .sth .s-manifest{padding:clamp(56px,8vw,110px) 0 clamp(56px,8vw,100px)}
body .sth .s-man-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:clamp(24px,6vw,96px);align-items:end}
body .sth .s-man-head h2{font-size:clamp(38.4px,6vw,83.2px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:.98}
body .sth .s-man-head p{color:var(--muted);font-size:18.4px}
body .sth .s-list{margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,72px);border-top:2px solid var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:34px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,padding .2s}
body .sth .s-li:hover{background:var(--ice);padding-left:26px}
body .sth .s-li .s-n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-li h3{font-size:clamp(30.4px,4.2vw,54.4px);font-weight:800}
body .sth .s-li p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}
body .sth .s-li .s-go{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .2s,background .2s,color .2s}
body .sth .s-li:hover .s-go{background:var(--pink);color:var(--navy);transform:translateX(6px)}
body .sth .s-sos-sec{background:var(--yellow);padding:clamp(56px,8vw,112px) 0}
body .sth .s-sos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
body .sth .s-eyebrow{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13.6px;margin-bottom:16px}
body .sth .s-sos-sec h2{font-size:clamp(35.2px,5vw,67.2px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em}
body .sth .s-sos-sec .s-txt{margin:22px 0 32px;font-size:18.4px;max-width:480px;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-steps{display:grid;gap:14px}
body .sth .s-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:24px 28px}
body .sth .s-step b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:51.2px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;color:var(--lblue);width:44px}
body .sth .s-step span{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(21.6px,2.6vw,32px);line-height:1.1;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-step.s-hot{background:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-step.s-hot span{color:#fff}
body .sth .s-step.s-hot b{color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth .s-know{padding:clamp(56px,7vw,96px) 0}
body .sth .s-sec-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px;margin-bottom:34px;flex-wrap:wrap}
body .sth .s-sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(35.2px,5vw,67.2px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em}
body .sth .s-link-more{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-cards3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:30px 24px}
body .sth .s-kcard{text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
body .sth .s-kwrap{position:relative;transition:transform .3s}
body .sth .s-kcard:hover .s-kwrap{transform:translateY(-5px)}
body .sth .s-kart{aspect-ratio:8/5;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(1,35,76,.14);background-color:var(--navy);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
body .sth .s-klabel{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:-21px;z-index:2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:17.28px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;padding:13px 18px 13px 20px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(1,35,76,.32)}
body .sth .s-klabel svg{color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth .s-a1{background-image:var(--img-k1)}
body .sth .s-a2{background-image:var(--img-k2)}
body .sth .s-a3{background-image:var(--img-k3)}
body .sth .s-a4{background-image:var(--img-k4)}
body .sth .s-a5{background-image:var(--img-k5)}
body .sth .s-kcard p{margin:0;padding:34px 6px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
body .sth .s-kcta{border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,32px);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(1,48,101,.94),rgba(1,48,101,.62)),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-kcta h3{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(22.4px,2.2vw,28.8px);font-weight:800}
body .sth .s-join{color:#fff;padding:clamp(72px,9vw,128px) 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(1,48,101,.98) 0,rgba(1,48,101,.9) 50%,rgba(1,48,101,.55) 100%),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-join-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
body .sth .s-join h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(35.2px,4.6vw,60.8px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em}
body .sth .s-join .s-eyebrow{color:var(--yellow)}
body .sth .s-join .s-txt{margin:22px 0 0;color:#DCE8F5;font-size:18.4px;max-width:544px}
body .sth .s-tiles{display:grid;gap:16px}
body .sth .s-tile{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:24px;padding:28px 30px;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
body .sth a.s-tile:hover{border-color:var(--pink);transform:translateY(-3px)}
body .sth .s-tile h3{font-size:25.6px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px}
body .sth .s-tile p{color:var(--muted)}
body .sth .s-tile .s-ar{color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-social{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
body .sth .s-social a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-social a:hover{border-color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-partners{padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
body .sth .s-partners .s-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,80px);align-items:center}
body .sth .s-partners p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15.68px}
body .sth .s-logos{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
body .sth .s-logo-box{flex:1 1 130px;height:64px;border:2px dashed #9FB5CC;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12.8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:0 8px}
body .sth footer{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-foot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;padding:64px 0 48px}
body .sth .s-foot .s-brand img{height:96px}
body .sth .s-foot h4{color:#fff;font-size:16.8px;margin:0 0 16px}
body .sth .s-foot ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
body .sth .s-foot a{color:#D3E1F0;text-decoration:none}
body .sth .s-foot a:hover{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline}
body .sth .s-foot p{color:#D3E1F0;margin-top:16px;max-width:352px}
body .sth .s-legal{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:22px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14.72px;color:#D3E1F0}
body .sth .s-sos-fab{display:none}
html.js body .sth .s-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
html.js body .sth .s-reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
html{scroll-behavior:auto}
html.js body .sth .s-reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}
body .sth *{transition:none!important}
}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-nav{display:none}
body .sth .s-nav.open{display:flex;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:#fff;padding:8px var(--pad) 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
body .sth .s-nav.open a{padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:18.4px}
body .sth .s-burger{display:grid}
body .sth .s-hdr .s-btn-sm{display:none}
body .sth .s-hero .s-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-bottom:clamp(130px,22vw,190px)}
body .sth .s-bar{display:none}
body .sth .s-hero-logo{height:clamp(240px,58vw,340px)}
body .sth .s-finder-card,body .sth .s-sos-grid,body .sth .s-join-grid,body .sth .s-man-head,body .sth .s-partners .s-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body .sth .s-cards3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
body .sth .s-foot{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
body .sth .s-foot>div:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}
body .sth .s-sos-fab{display:inline-flex;position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:60;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(1,35,76,.4)}
}
@media (max-width:700px){
body .sth .s-util .s-lang,body .sth .s-util .s-hide-m{display:none}
body .sth .s-brand img{height:60px}
body .sth .s-brand span{display:none}
body .sth .s-cards3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body .sth .s-li{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;padding:26px 4px}
body .sth .s-li .s-n{display:none}
body .sth .s-li .s-go{width:48px;height:48px}
body .sth .s-step{padding:18px 20px}
}

body .sth .s-lang a{text-decoration:none}
body .sth .s-lang a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
body .sth .s-foerder{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}
body .sth .s-foerder img{max-height:96px;width:auto;height:auto;display:block}
body .sth img{max-width:100%}
body .sth-skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0}
body .sth-skip:focus{left:16px;top:16px;background:#fff;color:#013065;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;z-index:200}
@media (max-width:1000px){body .sth .s-foerder{justify-content:flex-start}}
/* Finder mobil */
body .sth .s-optwrap{display:block}
body .sth .s-optpanel{display:none}
body .sth .s-chev{display:none}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-finder-card>.s-result{display:none}
body .sth .s-finder-card{padding:20px 16px}
body .sth .s-chev{display:block;margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;width:22px;height:22px;transition:transform .2s}
body .sth .s-opt[aria-expanded="true"] .s-chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
body .sth .s-opt[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0}
body .sth .s-opt.s-danger[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
body .sth .s-opt[aria-expanded="true"] .s-ic{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-optwrap{scroll-margin-top:96px}
body .sth .s-optpanel:not([hidden]){display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;background:var(--ice);border-radius:0 0 18px 18px;padding:18px 16px 20px;animation:sth-open .25s ease}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-rhead h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-rhead p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-rows{gap:8px}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-row{padding:12px 14px}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-row strong{font-size:17px}
body .sth .s-optpanel .s-row span{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4}

/* Header fix */

}
/* Ende Header fix */
/* Quiz-Band Startseite */
.s-qzband{padding:clamp(28px,4vw,44px) 0}
.s-qzband-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr;gap:clamp(16px,2.4vw,24px)}
.s-qzb{border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(1,35,76,.16)}
.s-qzb-text{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--teal),#1FC3D1);padding:clamp(28px,4vw,48px) clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.s-qzband-eye{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(1,48,101,.16);color:var(--navy);font:700 13px var(--body);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;align-self:flex-start}
.s-qzb-text h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#fff;margin:0 0 10px}
body .sth .s-qzb-text p{margin:0 0 32px;color:rgba(1,48,101,.82);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.5;max-width:32rem}
.s-qzb-img{overflow:hidden;min-height:180px}
.s-qzb-img img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

html body .sth .s-row,html body .sth .s-rowstep,html body .sth .s-step,html body .sth .s-tile,html body .sth .s-key,html body .sth .s-dt,html body .sth .s-form,html body .sth .s-report,html body .sth .s-arg{background:var(--surf)}

html body .sth .s-row strong,html body .sth .s-rowstep span,html body .sth .s-step span,html body .sth .s-dt summary,html body .sth .s-rbar .s-rl,html body .sth .s-rbar .s-rl b,html body .sth .s-wlist b,html body .sth .s-cline dt,html body .sth .s-qbox blockquote p,html body .sth .s-quote p{color:#fff}

/* Unterseite Internet */
body .sth .s-mgroup{margin-top:32px}
body .sth .s-mbtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:72px;padding:0 34px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
body .sth .s-mbtn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
body .sth .s-mnote{margin:16px 0 0;color:#DCE8F5;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;max-width:30rem}
body .sth .s-qbox{background:var(--ice);border-radius:24px;border-left:8px solid var(--pink);padding:clamp(24px,4vw,48px)}
body .sth .s-qbox blockquote p{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,34px);line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--navy);margin:0}
body .sth .s-qbox cite{display:block;margin-top:18px;font-style:normal;font-weight:700;color:var(--lblue);font-size:17px}
body .sth .s-qnote{margin:18px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
@media (max-width:700px){
body .sth .s-mbtn{width:100%;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;padding:0 22px}
}
/* Unterseiten Internet */
body .sth .s-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
body .sth .s-melde-btn{min-height:64px;padding:0 34px;font-size:20px}
body .sth .s-hnote{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;color:#C9D8EA;max-width:34rem}
body .sth .s-melde{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:calc(-1*clamp(84px,9vw,124px))}
body .sth .s-meldecard{background:#fff;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(1,35,76,.2);padding:clamp(24px,3.4vw,44px)}
body .sth .s-meldecard h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:22px}
body .sth .s-msteps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
body .sth .s-mstep{background:var(--ice);border-radius:20px;padding:22px}
body .sth .s-mn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:12px}
body .sth .s-mstep h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px}
body .sth .s-mstep p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
body .sth .s-mfoot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:18px 28px;margin-top:26px}
body .sth .s-mnote{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55;max-width:38rem;flex:1 1 300px}
body .sth .s-quote{border-left:6px solid var(--pink);background:var(--ice);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 32px}
body .sth .s-quote p{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,28px);line-height:1.3;color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-quote cite{display:block;margin-top:16px;font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-msteps{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
body .sth .s-partner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
body .sth .s-partner img{width:200px;height:auto;display:block}
body .sth .s-partner span{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;max-width:14rem}
body .sth .s-btnrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:18px 28px;margin-top:24px}
body .sth .s-tlink{color:var(--lblue);font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
body .sth .s-mgraphic{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;padding:clamp(64px,8vw,120px) 0 clamp(72px,9vw,132px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(1,48,101,.97),rgba(1,48,101,.88)),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-mgraphic .s-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
body .sth .s-arcs{position:absolute;width:min(46vw,560px);height:auto;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}
body .sth .s-arcs.s-arc-tr{top:0;right:0}
body .sth .s-arcs.s-arc-bl{bottom:0;left:0;transform:rotate(180deg)}
body .sth .s-jag{position:absolute;height:auto;opacity:.75;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
body .sth .s-mg-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:28px 48px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
body .sth .s-mgraphic h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(38px,5.6vw,76px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1;max-width:11ch;margin-bottom:22px}
body .sth .s-mg-head p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(18px,1.6vw,21px);line-height:1.55;color:#DCE8F5;max-width:34rem}
body .sth .s-mg-head .s-sticker{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(22px,2.3vw,30px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;padding:22px 28px;border-radius:20px;rotate:2deg;max-width:24rem;justify-self:end;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.28);border-bottom:8px solid var(--pink)}
body .sth .s-bubbles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:34px;align-items:start;padding-bottom:clamp(0px,7vw,112px)}
body .sth .s-bub{position:relative;border-radius:34px 34px 34px 8px;padding:40px 32px 34px;min-height:250px;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
body .sth .s-bub::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-24px;left:44px;width:44px;height:26px;background:inherit;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,0 100%)}
body .sth .s-bub h3{color:inherit;font-size:clamp(26px,2.6vw,34px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.08;margin-bottom:14px}
body .sth .s-bub p{margin:0;font-size:18px;line-height:1.5}
body .sth .s-bub .s-hl{background:linear-gradient(transparent 60%,var(--hlc) 60%);padding:0 .08em}
body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-y{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--navy);--hlc:rgba(255,43,156,.55);rotate:-1.6deg}
body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-t{background:var(--teal);color:var(--navy);--hlc:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:clamp(0px,4vw,56px);rotate:1.2deg}
body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-t::after{left:auto;right:44px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%)}
body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-p{background:var(--purple);color:#fff;--hlc:rgba(255,176,1,.85);margin-top:clamp(0px,8vw,112px);rotate:-.8deg}
body .sth .s-pin{position:absolute;top:-20px;right:26px;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.3);rotate:8deg}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-mg-head{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body .sth .s-mg-head .s-sticker{justify-self:start}
body .sth .s-bubbles{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px}
body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-t,body .sth .s-bub.s-bub-p{margin-top:0}
body .sth .s-arcs{width:70vw;opacity:.35}
body .sth .s-jag{display:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
body .sth .s-bub,body .sth .s-sticker{rotate:none}
}
body .sth .s-tl{list-style:none;margin:52px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0 44px;position:relative}
body .sth .s-tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:22px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--blue),var(--purple),var(--pink),var(--yellow))}
body .sth .s-tl>li{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;position:relative}
body .sth .s-tn{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #fff}
body .sth .s-tl h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:22px 0 8px}
body .sth .s-tl p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-tl{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}
body .sth .s-tl::before{left:22px;right:auto;top:0;bottom:0;width:6px;height:auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--teal),var(--blue),var(--purple),var(--pink),var(--yellow))}
body .sth .s-tl>li{padding-left:78px;min-height:50px}
body .sth .s-tn{position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
body .sth .s-tl h3{margin-top:4px}
}
/* Unterseiten Zeuge */
body .sth .s-zblock{scroll-margin-top:110px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;padding:clamp(56px,7vw,104px) 0 clamp(40px,5vw,72px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(1,48,101,.97),rgba(1,48,101,.9)),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-zblock h2{color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0}
body .sth .s-zblock .s-zlead{font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,22px);line-height:1.5;color:#E4EEF9;margin:18px 0 0;max-width:36rem}
body .sth .s-zintro{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:calc(-1*clamp(64px,7vw,96px));padding-bottom:clamp(48px,6vw,88px)}
body .sth .s-zcard{background:#fff;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(1,35,76,.2);padding:clamp(24px,3.2vw,44px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:28px clamp(28px,4vw,56px);align-items:start}
body .sth .s-zcard h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.2vw,44px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05;margin:0 0 16px}
body .sth .s-zpath{position:relative;height:480px;margin-top:20px;width:100vw;margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw)}
body .sth .s-zribbon{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
body .sth .s-zsteps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
body .sth .s-zs{position:absolute;width:min(290px,27%);transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
body .sth .s-zs.s-z1{left:16.4%;top:182px}
body .sth .s-zs.s-z2{left:50%;top:70px}
body .sth .s-zs.s-z3{left:83.6%;top:182px}
body .sth .s-zbadge{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:120px;height:120px;margin:0 auto 18px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #fff,0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
body .sth .s-z1 .s-zbadge{background:var(--teal);color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-z2 .s-zbadge{background:var(--pink);color:#fff}
body .sth .s-z3 .s-zbadge{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-zbadge svg{width:58px;height:58px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
body .sth .s-z110{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:44px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1}
body .sth .s-zn{position:absolute;left:-10px;top:-10px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #fff}
body .sth .s-zs h3{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(24px,2.3vw,30px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 8px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(1,30,66,.6)}
body .sth .s-zs p{margin:0;color:#E4EEF9;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(1,30,66,.6)}
body .sth .s-callout ul{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.7}
body .sth .s-zimg{display:block;max-width:440px}
body .sth .s-ausf{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(1,35,76,.18)}
body .sth .s-wlist{list-style:none;margin:22px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:12px}
body .sth .s-wlist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}
body .sth .s-wlist b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:21px;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em}
body .sth .s-facts{margin:36px 0 0;border-top:2px solid var(--line)}
body .sth .s-fact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,.7fr) 1.6fr;gap:12px 40px;padding:28px 0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
body .sth .s-fact h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:0}
body .sth .s-fact p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;line-height:1.65}
@media (max-width:1000px){
body .sth .s-zcard{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
body .sth .s-zpath{height:auto;margin-top:36px;width:auto;margin-left:0}
body .sth .s-zribbon{display:none}
body .sth .s-zsteps{display:grid;gap:36px;position:relative}
body .sth .s-zsteps::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:54px;top:40px;bottom:40px;width:12px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--teal),var(--blue),var(--purple),var(--pink),var(--yellow))}
body .sth .s-zs,body .sth .s-zs.s-z1,body .sth .s-zs.s-z2,body .sth .s-zs.s-z3{position:relative;left:auto;top:auto;width:auto;transform:none;text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:0 24px;align-items:center}
body .sth .s-zbadge{grid-row:1/3;margin:0}
body .sth .s-zs h3{align-self:end}
body .sth .s-zs p{align-self:start}
body .sth .s-fact{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body .sth .s-wlist li{grid-template-columns:120px 1fr}
}
/* Unterseiten Polizei */
body .sth .s-anchor{scroll-margin-top:110px}
body .sth .s-koop{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:calc(-1*clamp(64px,7vw,96px));padding-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
body .sth .s-koopcard{background:#fff;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(1,35,76,.2);padding:clamp(24px,3.2vw,44px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr;gap:28px 44px;align-items:center}
body .sth .s-koopcard h2{font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,36px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px}
body .sth .s-koopcard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
body .sth .s-koopact{display:grid;gap:14px;justify-items:start}
body .sth .s-koopact p{font-size:14.5px}
body .sth .s-koopprt{grid-column:1/-1;position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:6px}
body .sth .s-kband{position:absolute;left:calc(-1*clamp(24px,3.2vw,44px));right:calc(-1*clamp(24px,3.2vw,44px));top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);height:64px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--teal) 0 10px,transparent 10px 14px,var(--blue) 14px 24px,transparent 24px 28px,var(--purple) 28px 38px,transparent 38px 42px,var(--pink) 42px 52px,transparent 52px 56px,var(--yellow) 56px 64px)}
body .sth .s-kchip{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#fff;border-radius:26px;padding:18px 26px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #fff,0 14px 34px rgba(1,35,76,.18)}
body .sth .s-kchip.s-kmid{flex:none;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;padding:0}
body .sth .s-klogo{display:block;height:clamp(52px,6.6vw,84px);width:auto;max-width:100%}
body .sth .s-kshield{display:block;height:108px;width:auto}
body .sth .s-kchip.s-kfix{flex:none;width:clamp(200px,23vw,268px);aspect-ratio:2/1;padding:0}
body .sth .s-klogo.s-kv{width:84%;height:76%;object-fit:contain}
body .sth .s-klogo.s-kl{width:70%;height:64%;object-fit:contain}
body .sth .s-ansp{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;padding:clamp(64px,8vw,112px) 0 clamp(64px,8vw,112px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(1,48,101,.97),rgba(1,48,101,.9)),var(--img-dark) center/cover no-repeat,var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-ansp h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,62px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.02;max-width:15ch;margin:0 0 clamp(36px,5vw,64px)}
body .sth .s-stations{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);position:relative}
body .sth .s-route{display:none;grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1;align-self:center;margin:0 calc(50% - 50vw);height:76px;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--teal) 0 12px,transparent 12px 16px,var(--blue) 16px 28px,transparent 28px 32px,var(--purple) 32px 44px,transparent 44px 48px,var(--pink) 48px 60px,transparent 60px 64px,var(--yellow) 64px 76px)}
body .sth .s-st{position:relative;z-index:1}
body .sth .s-sphoto{position:relative}
body .sth .s-sphoto img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:5/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 28%;border-radius:24px;border:6px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
body .sth .s-scredit{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:16px;background:rgba(1,48,101,.82);color:#fff;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:8px}
body .sth .s-st h3{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,38px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05;margin:clamp(28px,3vw,40px) 0 8px}
body .sth .s-ansp .s-psub{color:var(--yellow);margin:0 0 16px}
body .sth .s-st .s-sdesc{color:#DCE8F5;font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;margin:0}
body .sth .s-ansp .s-cline{margin:22px 0 0}
body .sth .s-ansp .s-cline dt{color:#fff}
body .sth .s-ansp .s-cline dd{color:#DCE8F5}
body .sth .s-ansp .s-tlink{color:#fff}
body .sth .s-sbtn2{margin:26px 0 0}
body .sth .s-snote{grid-column:1/-1;margin:40px auto 0;max-width:46rem;text-align:center;color:#DCE8F5;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}
@supports (grid-template-rows:subgrid){
body .sth .s-stations .s-st{display:grid;grid-template-rows:subgrid;grid-row:1/span 6}
body .sth .s-stations .s-st.s-sa{grid-column:1}
body .sth .s-stations .s-st.s-sb{grid-column:2}
body .sth .s-route{display:block}
body .sth .s-snote{grid-row:7}
body .sth .s-cols2{grid-template-rows:repeat(5,auto)}
body .sth .s-cols2 .s-pcol{display:grid;grid-template-rows:subgrid;grid-row:span 5}
}
body .sth .s-psub{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:21px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--lblue)}
body .sth .s-cline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px 18px;margin:22px 0 0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5}
body .sth .s-cline dt{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin:0}
body .sth .s-cline dd{margin:0;color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
body .sth .s-vwrap{display:grid;justify-items:center}
body .sth .s-vph{width:100%;max-width:340px;aspect-ratio:9/13;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy),var(--purple));color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;align-content:center;gap:16px;padding:28px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(1,35,76,.25)}
body .sth .s-vplay{display:grid;place-items:center;width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--navy)}
body .sth .s-vph p{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;line-height:1.25}
body .sth .s-blead{max-width:44rem;margin:18px 0 0;font-size:19px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}
body .sth .s-tlsub{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--lblue);margin:44px 0 0}
body .sth .s-tlsub+.s-tl{margin-top:34px}
body .sth .s-tlnote{margin:30px 0 0;font-size:16px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ===== Beratung finden: vier Bundeslaender und bundesweit (v62) ===== */

body .sth .s-hf-azd summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:18px 22px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,24px);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--navy)}

body .sth .s-hf-azd summary::after{content:"";flex:none;width:12px;height:12px;border-right:3px solid currentColor;border-bottom:3px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);margin:-6px 4px 0 0;transition:transform .2s}

}

						<script>
				( () => {
					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
			</script>
